description: NEW (Nov 2026) — Suno Speech: expressive spoken audio (tone, rhythm, emotion, optional background music). NOT fixed-voice TTS — there is no voice list; you describe the delivery. 12 credits per request. TWO MODES: (1) Simple — pass prompt only (a scene description, ≤3000 chars) and the model writes the script. (2) Advanced — pass script (the exact words, ≤5000 chars) plus optional tone, variety, vocal_gender, background_music. Do not mix prompt with the Advanced fields. For a specific named voice use generate_gemini_tts instead. Downloads to kie/assets/raw/.

download_dir.description: Absolute directory to save the file(s) into (created if missing). Defaults to the server's kie/assets/raw/.

estimate_only.description: Return the estimated credit cost WITHOUT submitting anything. Use before expensive runs (video, 4K, 1080p upgrades, layer splits).

max_credits.description: Refuse to submit if the estimated cost exceeds this many credits (overrides KIE_MAX_CREDITS_PER_CALL). Estimates come from published rates; kie bills the actual amount.

max_wait_seconds.description: Override the blocking-mode polling budget in seconds. Ignored when wait=false.

prompt.description: Simple mode: one-line scene description, e.g. "A calm bedtime story intro about a fox" (1-3000 chars). The model writes the words.

script.description: Advanced mode: the exact text to speak (1-5000 chars)

tone.description: Advanced: delivery direction, e.g. "Warm, calm female narrator, slightly smiling" (≤1000 chars)

variety.description: Advanced: integer 0-4 — how much the delivery varies

wait.description: Set false to submit and return immediately with the task_id (async mode) — then poll with check_task and fetch with download_result.

name: generate_speech
